item.title: No. 9 Oklahoma Baptist men improve to 20-2 by routing arch-rivals
item.description: BETHANY – Ninth-ranked (NABC) Oklahoma Baptist raced out to an early double-digit lead and never looked back Thursday night, defeating rival Southern Nazarene 72-56 at the Sawyer Center. OBU won for the 11th straight time, improved its record to 20-2 overall and 14-2 in the Great American Conference, heading into a road game at Southeastern Oklahoma State.

item.title: Powered by dominant second half, Bison women defeat SNU 70-61
item.description: BETHANY, Okla. – A dominant second-half performance powered Oklahoma Baptist to a 70–61 road victory over Southern Nazarene on Thursday night inside the Sawyer Center.

item.title: Frozen fruits, vegetables now eligible for Double Up Oklahoma program at Shawnee Homeland store
item.description: Hunger Free Oklahoma, in partnership with HAC, Inc., is now allowing frozen fruits and vegetables as eligible produce in the Double Up Oklahoma (DUO) program at the Homeland grocery store in Shawnee (Store #196).

item.title: City names Petya Stefanoff community development director
item.description: The City of Shawnee recently announced the promotion and appointment of Petya Stefanoff as director of Community Development, as approved by the Shawnee City Commission during February’s meeting.Stefanoff joined the city in 2024 and brings more than a decade of experience in state and local government, along with private-sector experience in engineering and architectural firms across several states. item.title: Presidents' Day: Notable Presidential firsts
item.description: The third Monday in February is set aside for Presidents' Day in the United States, which is actually referred to as Washington's Birthday on the federal calendar. Washington's Birthday had always been celebrated on February 22, but with the passage of the Uniform Monday Holiday Act in 1968, the holiday was moved.

item.title: Presidential record holders
item.description: The presidency is the highest office an individual can hold in the United States. Though that's the same for everyone who earns a spot in the Oval Office, each presidency is unique, and some presidents have even set records during their time at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.

item.title: Pioneer Library System Foundation to host Mad Hatter Tea Party March 28
item.description: SHAWNEE – The Pioneer Library System Foundation invites the community to enter Wonderland at the 4th Annual Mad Hatter Tea Party fundraiser on Saturday, March 28. The event returns to the Shawnee Public Library, transforming the space for an evening of food, specialty cocktails and mocktails, live entertainment, raffle packages, and the popular “Maddest Hat” contest.

item.title: SPS honors Blanche McVey as Transportation Support Employee of the Year
item.description: Blanche McVey was recently named the Shawnee Public Schools Transportation Support Employee of the Year. McVey has faithfully served the district for 30 years, a true example of dedication and consistency.

item.title: SPS honors Jacque Knight at Child Nutrition Support Employee of the Year
item.description: Shawnee Public Schools announces that Jacque Knight has been named the SPS Child Nutrition Support Employee of the Year. Knight has found a simple, yet powerful, way to bring even more positivity into the cafeteria.
